user.title: Add a Škoda
user.description:
An unofficial integration, not made or supported by Škoda; it uses Škoda's official public API.

Create an API key in the MyŠkoda app: Settings → Smart Home → API keys, or open [go.skoda.eu/api-keys]({api_keys_url}) on your phone. Select the vehicle the key may access and copy the key at once; it is shown only one time.

data_description.vin: The 17-character vehicle identification number, as shown in the MyŠkoda app and on the registration certificate.
data_description.api_key: The key created in the MyŠkoda app for this vehicle.

data_description.base_url: Where the MyŠkoda Public API is reached. Leave unchanged unless Škoda moves it or you run a test server.

reauth_confirm.title: New API key needed
reauth_confirm.description: The API key of {name} has expired or no longer covers the vehicle. Create or update a key in the MyŠkoda app ([go.skoda.eu/api-keys]({api_keys_url})) and enter it here.

data_description.api_key: The new key for this vehicle.

reconfigure.title: Replace the API key
reconfigure.description: Enter a new API key for {name}. Keys are created in the MyŠkoda app ([go.skoda.eu/api-keys]({api_keys_url})).

data_description.api_key: The new key for this vehicle.

error.invalid_vin: A VIN has 17 characters: digits and capital letters, without I, O and Q.
error.invalid_auth: The API key is invalid or has expired.
error.key_not_authorized: This API key does not cover this vehicle. Update the key in the MyŠkoda app and select the vehicle.
error.vehicle_not_found: No vehicle with this VIN is known.
error.rate_limited: Too many requests for this vehicle. Try again later.
error.cannot_connect: The Škoda service cannot be reached.

abort.already_configured: This vehicle is already set up.
abort.reauth_successful: The new API key is in use.
abort.reconfigure_successful: The new API key is in use.

data_description.poll_interval: How often the vehicle data is fetched. The API allows 20 requests per vehicle and hour; commands use that budget too.
data_description.active_poll_interval: How often the data is fetched while the vehicle charges or runs its air conditioning, auxiliary heating or ventilation. Never slower than the update interval.
data_description.fast_poll_when_plugged: Also use the shorter interval while a charging cable is plugged in, without charging.
data_description.auto_wake_minutes: When a charging vehicle has not reported for this many minutes, ask it for fresh data. Each wake is a command of the hourly quota. 0 switches it off; otherwise 10 to 120.
data_description.spin: Only needed to start the auxiliary heating. Leave empty to remove it.
data_description.readonly: Show the vehicle without any controls.

error.invalid_auto_wake: Enter 0 to switch it off, or 10 to 120 minutes.

api_key_expiring.title: The API key of {name} expires on {date}
api_key_expiring.description: Create or update a key in the MyŠkoda app, then use Reconfigure on the MyŠkoda Public API integration to enter it. After the expiry date the vehicle data stops updating.

auth_failed.message: The API key is invalid, has expired, or does not cover this vehicle.

rate_limited.message: Too many requests for this vehicle; waiting for the quota to refill.

update_failed.message: The vehicle data could not be fetched: {error}

readonly.message: This vehicle is set to read only.

command_not_authorized.message: The vehicle refused the command for the owner of the API key.

vehicle_declined.message: The vehicle is not accepting commands right now. Try again in about {minutes} min.

command_rate_limited.message: The hourly request quota of this vehicle is used up. Try again in about {minutes} min.

refresh_rate_limited.message: The API asked to wait until {time} before the next request; the data shown is the last received.

command_disabled.message: This function is currently switched off for the vehicle.

command_not_supported.message: The vehicle does not support this function.

command_not_found.message: The vehicle or the charging profile is unknown.

vehicle_timeout.message: The vehicle did not respond in time.

cannot_connect.message: The Škoda service cannot be reached.

cable_not_connected.message: Charging cannot start: no charging cable is connected.

spin_required.message: Starting the auxiliary heating needs the S-PIN. Enter it in the options of the integration.

profile_entry_not_found.message: The charging profile has no entry {id} in {field}.

vehicle_not_loaded.message: This device is not a loaded MyŠkoda Public API vehicle.

nothing_to_change.message: Give at least one value to change.

profile_entry_position_not_found.message: The charging profile has {count} entries in {field}; there is no position {position}.

wake_command_pending.message: A command is still waiting for the vehicle; wake it once that is done.

wake_not_possible.message: The vehicle cannot be woken: it does not report a charge mode or does not accept a new one.

auto_wake_range.message: Enter 0 to switch the automatic wake off, or {min} to {max} minutes.

stop_air_conditioning.name: Stop air conditioning
stop_air_conditioning.description: Stops the air conditioning of a vehicle.

stop_auxiliary_heating.name: Stop auxiliary heating
stop_auxiliary_heating.description: Stops the auxiliary heater of a vehicle.

start_active_ventilation.name: Start active ventilation
start_active_ventilation.description: Starts the active ventilation of a vehicle.

stop_active_ventilation.name: Stop active ventilation
stop_active_ventilation.description: Stops the active ventilation of a vehicle.

set_charging_limit.name: Set charge limit
set_charging_limit.description: Sets the state of charge at which a vehicle stops charging.

target_state_of_charge.name: Charge limit
target_state_of_charge.description: Vehicles typically accept 50 to 100 % in steps of 10.

set_charge_mode.name: Set charge mode
set_charge_mode.description: Changes how a vehicle decides when to charge.

charge_mode.name: Charge mode
charge_mode.description: One of the modes the vehicle offers.

start_air_conditioning.name: Start air conditioning
start_air_conditioning.description: Starts the air conditioning of a vehicle, optionally towards a temperature.

temperature.name: Temperature
temperature.description: Target cabin temperature. Without it the vehicle uses its last one.

without_external_power.name: Without external power
without_external_power.description: Allow the air conditioning to run on the battery when no charger is connected.

start_auxiliary_heating.name: Start auxiliary heating
start_auxiliary_heating.description: Starts the auxiliary heater of a vehicle. Needs the S-PIN.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: How long the heater runs. Without it the vehicle uses its own setting.

spin.name: S-PIN
spin.description: Only needed when no S-PIN is stored in the options.

update_charging_profile.name: Update charging profile
update_charging_profile.description: Changes a charging profile (saved charging location). Only the given values change.

profile.name: Profile
profile.description: Name or id of the charging profile.

target_state_of_charge.name: Charge limit
target_state_of_charge.description: State of charge at which charging stops at this location.

auto_unlock_plug.name: Unlock cable when charged
auto_unlock_plug.description: Release the charging cable once charging has finished.

min_battery_enabled.name: Minimum charge
min_battery_enabled.description: Charge at once, whatever the schedule, while the battery is below the minimum level.

min_battery_state_of_charge.name: Minimum charge level
min_battery_state_of_charge.description: Level below which charging starts at once.

preferred_charging_times.name: Preferred charging times
preferred_charging_times.description: List of changes. Each names a charging time by its id (the number in its entity name), or by position (its place in the list, from 1), and gives any of enabled, start_time and end_time (HH:MM).

timers.name: Timers
timers.description: List of changes. Each names a timer by its id (the number in its entity name), or by position (its place in the list, from 1), and gives any of enabled, time (HH:MM), type (one_off or recurring), one_off_day and recurring_on (weekdays).
